items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rend T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Spirit Snatch. Ultimate (Eternal Night) is available from Cold Front.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 11200 souls (~11.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Stalker
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Crushing Fists, 29600 souls (~29.6 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Spirit Snatch completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Spirit Snatch completes 4.8k spirit in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Spirit Snatch completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Spirit Snatch completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Cold Front
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k spirit tier, which Spirit Snatch completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Snatch completes 4.8k spirit in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 5,600 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Upgrade of Spirit Strike (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.legacy_note: Maxed Rend counts as a heavy melee, so it triggers this too.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Health
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Lifestrike completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Lifestrike completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-25,600 (levels 16-28). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Stalker's Mark T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Rend, bonus damage) grows from 156 to 213. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Lifestrike.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k vitality tier, which Fortitude completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Fortitude completes 6.4k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Fortitude
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Melee Charge
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Crushing Fists, 13600 souls (~13.6 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Tankbuster
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Veil Walker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 11,200 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Stalker's Mark: its duration-scaled parts (duration 8s) get +22%. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 11,200 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Eternal Night duration (6.5s), Eternal Night reveal duration (3s), Bloodscent trail duration (10s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 27,200-43,200 (levels 29-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bloodscent T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Crushing Fists.

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k, 8k tiers): bonus 18 to 62% weapon damage. Upgrade of Melee Charge (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
sections.desc: Dying after Lifestrike? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry turns and out-shoots you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps ticking on you, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes stop you chasing or getting out.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep stopping you before you can finish them.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Cold Front for 4,800 more souls: damage 95 to 175; tech resist 6 to 10..

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 24,000 to 30,400 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. | +30 spirit adds about 42 to Rend's bonus damage (1.40x scaling).
items.legacy_note: Sell Stalker for this, or Trophy Collector if it's gone.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage. Takes spirit from 24,000 to 30,400 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Sell Trophy Collector for this, or Veil Walker if it's gone.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
